item.title: Why Load Tests Underreport p99: Reproducing Coordinated Omission in Python
item.description: One response takes 800 ms, yet the load test reports a p99 of 5 ms. A client that waits for each response before sending its next request skips requests that would otherwise arrive during the pause. When the intended workload has independent arrivals, this gap in measurement is called coordinated omission.
